author_or_account: Tilburg University School of Economics and Management
title: Unlocking Mortgage Lock-In: Evidence from a Spatial Housing Ladder Model
discussion_signal: The seminar relay describes mortgage lock-in as reducing mobility and reshaping prices, rents, downsizing, and policy effectiveness, with discussion emphasizing that the constraint persists beyond the initial rate shock.
linked_research_question: How does mortgage lock-in redistribute mobility, housing supply, rents, and the gains from policies intended to unlock the housing ladder?
limits: This is a seminar relay rather than a platform-native discussion of the paper
The post summarizes model-based findings and does not establish local effects in every market
